faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulraheem?
faq.a: Abdulraheem is associated with Arabic. Abdulraheem is Arabic عَبْدُ الرَّحِيم (ʿAbd al-Raḥīm), meaning 'servant of the Most Merciful'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الرَّحِيم is Arabic.
Abdulraheem can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdulraheem should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-Raḥīm is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.
